checks.finding: requirements.md:46-52 requires each component's applicable classifications, and acceptance-tests.md:9-10 expects their values to match the OQ-001 decision record. requirements.md:323-360 records the nine component IDs and ownership rationale but does not specify per-component classification values or criteria. An implementer or verifier therefore cannot determine the expected Context fields; this is a Phase-1 specification gap, not a later implementation choice.
Each stated requirement has at least one mapped criterion: requirements.md:35-190 defines REQ-001 through REQ-014, and acceptance-tests.md:9-37 maps AC-001 through AC-034 to those requirements.

The acceptance criteria define observable schema, publication, ownership, resolver, evidence, and rejection outcomes, including exact Phase-1/Phase-2 tuples and rollback branches (acceptance-tests.md:9-37, requirements.md:218-251).
The specification explicitly excludes later Pack types, replacing existing mechanisms, UI/cloud deployment, a new CI workflow, and agent approval of protected artifacts (requirements.md:197-205).

Approval and protected-publication boundaries, rollback authorization, cross-platform compatibility, dependency readiness, and ownership constraints are stated (requirements.md:35-44, 147-184, 302-318).
High-risk approval, rollback, credential, release-write, and promotion claims have planned rejection or evidence checks (acceptance-tests.md:10, 20-24, 30-37; requirements.md:129-155).
